buildables.name: Wood Floor
buildables.description: Clean timber floorboards. Can be placed on grass courtyard.

buildables.name: Wood Wall
buildables.description: Solid timber wall. Automatically connects to adjacent walls and doors.

buildables.name: Wood Door
buildables.description: Passable wooden door frame. Required to enclose indoor rooms.

buildables.name: Research Station
buildables.description: Guild crafting station. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room with walls and a door.

buildables.name: Bed
buildables.description: Comfortable wooden guild bed for resting. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Alchemy Station
buildables.description: Guild alchemy workbench. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Cooking Station
buildables.description: Guild cooking stove and preparation station. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Blacksmithing Station
buildables.description: Guild forge and anvil for smelting ore and crafting weapons. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Armorsmithing Bench
buildables.description: Guild bench for tailoring hides and weaving silk into protective armor. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Bowyer Station
buildables.description: Guild bowcrafting workbench for shaping staves, strings, and crafting ranged bows. Requires a fully enclosed indoor room.

buildables.name: Planting Plot
buildables.description: Tilled soil plot for planting seeds and cultivating vegetables. Costs 3 Clay to construct.

buildables.name: Seed Maker
buildables.description: Extracts viable seeds from fresh produce. Place in Outpost, insert 1 vegetable, wait for processing, and collect 2 seeds.
